svg.title: Governed Agentic Security Workflow
svg.desc: End-to-end workflow for the agentic lab: GitHub Actions supply chain, telemetry ingestion, multi-agent analysis, OPA governance with optional signed human approval, MCP-brokered remediation on GKE, and BigQuery evidence.

text.tspan: lab: GitHub Actions to GKE agents, OPA / KMS approval,

g.text: ci.yml route tree / release.yml signed images
namespace security + GCP telemetry into one ingest topic
ai-agents namespace / Pub/Sub between hops / Vertex does not authorize

text.tspan: Gemini may summarize and recommend. It never authorizes.
Governance is deterministic OPA. Before any MCP call, the
Remediation Agent re-validates the decision, policy SHA-256,
Remediation Agent verifies the decision, policy id, policy SHA-256,
approval signature, expiry, namespace and deployment allowlists,
severity, confidence, evidence count, and prior Firestore execution
state. Missing or stale data is rejected.

g.text: MCP is the only path to Kubernetes / mTLS / EXECUTION_MODE=controlled
